title: introduce-sampled-eviction-metrics-and-alert-consolidation
author: Aisha Nguyen
description:
Summary: Add first-class metrics and dashboard panels for sampled-eviction events from the telemetry sampler, and consolidate noisy token-cost alerts by introducing an alert-coalescer that groups related signals. Motivation: We see high alert churn from token-cost SLOs during prefixed-burst traffic; a large fraction of traces were dropped by the sampling pipeline and the resulting partial telemetry produces duplicate/partial alerts. This PR exposes eviction metrics (reason/tag), surfaces them in dashboards, and adds an alert-coalescer to reduce noise while preserving SLO fidelity. Changes include: 1) runtime: attach `telemetry.eviction_reason` to spans when the sampler evicts (hot, cold, rate-limit, memory-pressure), and emit an aggregate counter+histogram for eviction durations and counts; 2) metrics: prometheus metrics `redwood_sampler_evictions_total`, `redwood_sampler_eviction_latency_ms_bucket`, and labels for reason/route/model_family; 3) dashboards: new Grafana panel group "Sampler Eviction & Coalesced Alerts" with heatmap and stacked counters; 4) alerts: an `eviction-aware` alert-coalescer rule that groups token-cost anomalies by route+eviction_reason for 10m windows before firing, and a tuned SLO fallback that only fires when eviction_rate < 5% to avoid false positives during sampling storms; 5) docs: telemetry-runbook entry describing eviction telemetry and how to interpret the dashboard; 6) tests: unit + e2e tests that simulate sampling eviction and verify metrics emitted and alert grouping behavior. Backwards compatibility: metrics added are additive; the new eviction tag is optional when the sampler is disabled. Rollout: feature-flag gated (telemetry.eviction=true) and staged to prod via canary (10%->50%->100%) with an automatic rollback if alarm rate increases. Checklist:
- [x] Runtime instrumentation + unit tests
- [x] Prometheus metric definitions and registries updated
- [x] Grafana dashboard JSON and panels added
- [x] Alert-rule and coalescer implementation + integration tests
- [x] Documentation and runbook
- [x] Canary rollout recipe
Links: Linear ENG-1583, ENG-1799; incident notes SUP-412; related discussion https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1583/sampled-evictions-dashboard

review_comments: Marco Ruiz (2026-02-16): Nice approach. Two asks: 1) add route-level cardinality guard for the reason label, 2) ensure the histogram buckets are compatible with existing latency dashboards. Also spotted a small formatting lint in the dashboard JSON.
Aisha Nguyen (2026-02-16): Reply: added a cardinality_guard() that drops high-cardinality route labels and updated histogram buckets to match latency panel. Fixed dashboard JSON formatting.
Samir Patel (2026-02-17): We're seeing CI flaky on the e2e test when run in parallel; can we isolate prometheus scrape start?
Aisha Nguyen (2026-02-17): Reworked the e2e to use a mock registry and deterministic scrape timing; CI now stable.
Claire Donovan (2026-02-18): Approved after minor nits resolved. Asked for a short runbook blurb which was added.
release_notes:
- Add sampler eviction telemetry (counts, latency histograms) with reason labels.
- New Grafana dashboard: "Sampler Eviction & Coalesced Alerts".
- Alert coalescer that groups token-cost anomalies by route+eviction_reason to reduce noise.
- Documentation: telemetry runbook + rollout playbook.
summary: Adds sampled-eviction metrics, dashboard, and an alert coalescer to reduce SLO alert noise caused by partial telemetry during sampling storms. Gated behind feature flag and rolled out via canary.
notes_on_rollout: Feature flag telemetry.eviction=true. Canary plan: enable on canary fleet (10%) for 2 hours -> validate eviction_rate and alert volume -> 50% for 6 hours -> full rollout. Auto rollback if alert_rate increases by >50% or eviction_rate spikes >20% absolute.
test_strategy: Unit tests for metric emission, mock-prometheus scrape in CI, and e2e test that replays sampled traces and validates the coalescer groups alerts as expected. Tests added to tests/e2e/sampler-eviction.test.ts and run in the telemetry CI job.
